title: The Early Black Friday Bargains Worth Bagging
author: Simon Hill
text:
All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.While the Friday after Thanksgiving has traditionally been the busiest shopping day of the year, Black Friday deals have gradually spread well beyond the day. First came Cyber Monday, then Cyber Week. Now, early Black Friday deals kick off before November has even started. The tricky part for early birds is knowing what’s a genuine deal and what’s likely to go even lower when Black Friday arrives. This is the Thanksgiving Day list.Featured Prime Day DealUpdated: Nov 26 2026, 07:29 PMSamsung Galaxy Z Fold8 $1900 $1550The passport size Z Fold8 is our favorite folding phone.The Reviews team at WIRED tracks prices on our favorite gadgets year-round, and we highlight deals only on devices we’ve tested and would recommend to our own friends and family. Some of these prices may reduce even more for Black Friday and Cyber Monday, but these are the discounts that have caught our eye today—vetted for price hikes and fake deals. And if you’re looking for something more distinctive and gift-worthy, we’ve curated some special finds on sale.Updated Thursday, November 26: Happy Thanksgiving! We’ve added new deals on the Apple AirPods Max 2 headphones, Fairphone (Gen 6+) smartphone, Anker Laptop power bank, Viture Beast smart glasses, LG C6 OLED TV, Dell XPS 13 laptop, Dawn Powerwash spray, Flexispot EN1 standing desk, TerraMow V1000 robot lawn mower, Technivorm Moccamaster KBGT coffee machine, and Google Pixel Watch 5, and checked for accuracy throughout. This fantastic overshirt is 25% off on their online shop.Just My Type: I love the wooden accents on our favorite mechanical keyboard, which is finally under $100.A Step Up: Meermin makes GQ’s favorite affordable loafer, and their Chelsea boot is just as comfortable and well made—now 40% off.For Small Pets: You can save 50% on the Fi Mini.Rest Easy: A good night’s sleep is a gift for life. Our favorite hybrid mattress topper is 25% off. I also grabbed some new towels and bedding from Parachute.Top Deals: What do you get the guy with too many chore coats? A Harrington jacket—like this excellent one from Todd Snyder, which is 30% off an already half-off ticket.Travel Lighter: Away’s The Everywhere Bag is 25% off and pairs with your new luggage.Curated by Cooper Fleishman, Executive Commerce Director

It's a powerful phone with a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and has plenty of stamina thanks to the 4,800-mAh silicon-carbon battery. The accessory maker has an early Black Friday sale on now with up to 30 percent off this and other accessories.Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerLaptop Power Bank$135 $91 (33% off) Amazon$120 Shop$120 AnkerMost PopularDealsAmazon’s ‘Black Friday Week’ Sale Event Is Now Live Ahead of ThanksgivingBy Les ShuGearThe Best Black Friday 2026 Deals Are Live, Hot, and Ready for ThanksgivingBy Simon HillBuying GuidesWish List 2026: 27 Gifts for the Visionaries, Explorers, and Early Adopters in Your LifeBy Michael CaloreBuying GuidesThe 44 Best Gifts Under $100 That WIRED LovesBy Simon HillWhether you’re looking to fast charge your phone, juice up your tablet, or even refill your laptop, this power bank can do it all. It has lovely rounded edges, a retractable, flat, 2.3-foot USB-C cable on the top, and a snazzy, durable, braided 1-foot USB-C cable that doubles as a carry loop.Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillEcoflowRapid Pro Power Bank$250 $160 (36% off) Amazon$126 $60 (52% off) Amazon (20,000 mAh)Looking for a power bank that can keep your laptop, phone, and other gadgets powered up on the go? Look no further. The EcoFlow Rapid Pro is my top power bank for laptops because of the 27,650-mAh capacity (allowed on flights), three USB-C ports (rated at 140 watts, 65 watts, and 65 watts), and retractable 2-foot USB-C cable (rated at 140 watts).Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerMagGo UFO 3-in-1 Qi2 Charger$90 $60 (33% off) Amazon$90 Shop (Anker)If you have Apple's trio of gadgets (iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods), a 3-in-1 travel charger is a handy thing to own. This is the smallest option you'll find that's still usable, and it can squeeze into any overstuffed bag or case. Unfolded, there's a magnetic pad to charge your iPhone at up to 15 watts, a middle pad for your AirPods, and an Apple Watch charger on the right.Most PopularDealsAmazon’s ‘Black Friday Week’ Sale Event Is Now Live Ahead of ThanksgivingBy Les ShuGearThe Best Black Friday 2026 Deals Are Live, Hot, and Ready for ThanksgivingBy Simon HillBuying GuidesWish List 2026: 27 Gifts for the Visionaries, Explorers, and Early Adopters in Your LifeBy Michael CaloreBuying GuidesThe 44 Best Gifts Under $100 That WIRED LovesBy Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillUgreenUno 2-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Charger$60 $33 (45% off) AmazonGadgets are too boring. I immediately like it more than all my old faceless chargers. The charging pad supports Qi2/MagSafe and tilts up to 70 degrees to reveal a second pad to charge AirPods or other wireless earbuds. It even has a USB-C port for a third gadget. It’s only dual-band (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz), so there’s no 6-GHz option, and performance is limited, but for a small home with modest demands, this is a tough price to beat.Photograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenBelkinConnect USB-C 11-in-1 Pro GaN Dock$180 $131 (27% off) Amazon$200 $140 (30% off) B&H PhotoA good laptop docking station lets you convert your laptop into a desktop for a comfier experience when you’re working from home, and this compact beauty from Belkin is one of our top picks. GaN technology (gallium nitride semiconductors, a faster, more compact alternative to silicon) lets Belkin pack more ports than you can shake a USB-C cable at, including 96-watt power delivery, three 4K display ports, a gigabit Ethernet port, and more. This deal equals the lowest price we’ve seen.Photograph: Kat MerckFlexiSpotEN1 Standing Desk (48 X 30 Inches)$210 $161 (23% off) AmazonIt may not be the easiest to assemble, but the EN1 from FlexiSpot offers everything you need from a motorized standing desk at a reasonable price (especially with the Black Friday discount). The single motor can go from a height of 28 to 48 inches, and it doesn't wobble too much when fully extended. The desktop is made from environmentally friendly chipboard, but doesn't feel too cheap. You can also save three presets for quick switching to your preferred heights. It’s a self-contained triple-lens powerhouse, combining a 4K fixed main lens that has a 130-degree field of view with dual 2K lenses that pan through 360 degrees and tilt through 70 degrees. You can track and zoom in on subjects or license plates more than 150 feet away. The 10,000-mAh battery is topped off by the included solar panel. The Tapo app can detect motion (person, pet, vehicle) and enables you to set activity zones and privacy zones. The two-way audio is okay, and there’s a built-in alarm function. You can also slip a microSD card in for local recording. It lacks HDR, but it still earns a spot in our best outdoor security cameras guide. All lengths are on sale, but the 200-foot string has the best discount and is at its lowest price ever.Photograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellPhotograph: Nena FarrellEverblogHomeCal 21.5" Calendar$400 $280 (30% off) Amazon$399 $299 (25% off) Shop$399 $299 (25% off) EverblogIf you like to run an organized household, the best digital wall calendars are sure to appeal. It also works like a digital photo frame if you upload your snaps, and you can log into apps like Netflix and Spotify on it. This is the lowest we’ve seen it drop so far. It snaps 8-megapixel photos, captures 4K video, and includes a nifty AI bird-identification feature. You can banish this tedious, unpleasant task by snagging one of the best robot mowers. Forget about cheap mowers that require you to run wire around your garden or even mowers that need satellite navigation antennas. The TerraMow V1000 is perfect for most gardens, comes with a covered charging station, and automatically maps your lawn.Jump to a section: Apple Deals, Headphone Deals, Mobile Deals, TV and Speaker Deals, Laptop and Home Office Deals, Smart Home Deals, Home and Kitchen Deals, Health and Fitness DealsBest Home and Kitchen DealsPhotograph: Boutayna ChokraneHatchSleep Clock$250 $188 (25% off) HatchThe Hatch Sleep clock is an excellent all-in-one bedside companion. It's rare that every Reviews Team member agrees on a gadget, but every one of us who has tested it loves it. It's especially nice to have this time of year when waking up and getting to bed can feel extra difficult. The Hatch's lighting routines can help your circadian rhythm feel a bit more regulated compared to waking up in total darkness. It also has sleep tracking through the app—a great option if you hate wearing a sleep tracker on your body. There's an optional subscription ($6 per month) that gets you full access to the library of sleep sounds, but we don't think it's necessary.
